body_markdown:
Industry veteran Corey Burns has joined Middleby as Vice President, Middleby Advantage.


In this new Middleby role, Corey will lead the development and growth of customer-facing solutions across the Middleby portfolio. These include installation, preventive maintenance, connected kitchen monitoring, chain account engagement, and other lifecycle services designed to maximize customer value, improve their profitability, and strengthen Middleby long-term customer relationships.


“We are thrilled to welcome Corey to the Middleby Advantage team,” said Kevin Fink, SVP of Middleby Service. “His diverse background and deep industry experience will be an asset as launch new service initiatives companywide.”


Corey brings three decades of experience to Middleby, having worked throughout the foodservice industry in a variety of roles, including engineering, manufacturing, sales, and contributing to executive-level strategy.
